principle: Crew is generated from operational requirements and coverage; a reference complement is not a bag of random NPCs.
rules: Class crew_reference is guidance, not a live manifest or mandatory exact count.
Required staffing derives from systems, mission, safety, organization and watch coverage.
One person may cover multiple compatible duties only when time, qualification and command rules allow it.
A vacant slot remains a vacancy until a real assignment fills it.
Materializing a named crewmember consumes or occupies a valid staffing slot.
Passengers and civilians do not become duty crew merely because they are aboard.
Emergency staffing may temporarily violate normal patterns but must create explicit risk/exception state.
Generated crew identity follows persistent population materialization rules.
